title: JavaScript Kernel
description: Settings of the JavaScript kernels. The changes apply to the kernels started next, and after Kernel > Restart Kernel.

magicImports.title: Magic imports
magicImports.description: Load the packages imported by name, like import confetti from 'canvas-confetti', from a CDN. When disabled, only URLs and the specifiers of an import map can be imported.

magicImportsBaseUrl.title: CDN base URL
magicImportsBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the CDN serving the packages. A relative URL, like vendor/, is resolved against the URL of the JupyterLite site, to serve the packages from the deployment.

magicImportsNpmPrefix.title: Add the npm/ prefix
magicImportsNpmPrefix.description: Load 'lodash-es' from <CDN base URL>/npm/lodash-es, like jsDelivr serves the packages. Disable it for the CDNs serving the packages at their root, like esm.sh.

magicImportsEsmSuffix.title: Add the +esm suffix
magicImportsEsmSuffix.description: Add /+esm after the package paths which do not end with .js, .mjs, .cjs or .wasm, for jsDelivr to serve them as ES modules. Disable it for other CDNs.

loopTimeout.title: Loop timeout (ms)
loopTimeout.description: The time in milliseconds a loop can keep the page busy in the JavaScript (IFrame) kernel, which runs on the thread of the page, before it is stopped with a LoopTimeoutError. 0 turns it off. The JavaScript (Web Worker) kernel runs off the page thread, and has no loop timeout by default.

maxStreamOutput.title: Output limit (characters)
maxStreamOutput.description: The number of characters a cell can print with console.log() and the other console methods. The rest is not shown, with a notice. 0 for no limit.
